description: Lendflow lets lending teams work their pipeline from ChatGPT. Look up applications and the businesses behind them, review the offers and funder placements attached to a deal, see which documents are still outstanding, and move a deal to its next workflow status. Users sign in with their own Lendflow account and see only the records that account already has access to.
